label: [ Passoff Reading 149 ]

blocks.text: In many countries around the world, narrow - mindedness, religious impatience, greed, and fear have turned into crises that have taken the lives of millions. Many struggles such as rich versus poor are fought under deeply held beliefs. But given the destructive results, do these beliefs make sense? How often, in fact, do we stop to think about what we believe? One of the major problems we face both as individuals and as a society is simplistic thinking―or the failure to think at all. It isn’t just a problem; perhaps, it is the problem.
